text: For 10 years, OpenSSH on Alpine let a 257+ character password into accounts that were never supposed to take one. A researcher found it with agents and 12 sshd builds. Who's exposed, how to check, and the testing trick I'd copy.

author: EmunaEliran
text: Breach: ARTEX abuse expands as cybercriminals target financial sector. In October 2026, the financially motivated threat actor Storm-3358 began targeting organizations in the financial sector using the agentic AI offensive framework ARTEX.

author: Xtantdottech
text: Microsoft says attackers used agentic AI to hunt exposed GitHub secrets; in one case, an agent reached Azure Key Vault and exfiltrated data in five minutes. Rotate leaked credentials and scan beyond your own repos.

author: automationaix
text: Hackers are using AI tools to speed up attacks on everything from European supermarket fridges to crypto exchanges. In India, a group called "Crafty Falcon" used Chinese-linked AI tools to breach financial firms and steal money.

author: igor_os777
text: Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot | The Hacker News CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1, codenamed SSHole (or *sshole). Unauthenticated attackers can log in to accounts deliberately set up with no usable password.

author: 2logics
text: Security firms watchTowr and Previdian said on Friday that attackers are already exploiting SSHole (CVE-2026-123158), an OpenSSH flaw that lets anyone who can reach SSH on some Alpine and other musl-based Linux systems log in without knowing a password.

author: Xlab_qax
text: Since yesterday, CVE-2026-123158 (OpenSSH auth bypass, SSHole) has been actively exploited to distribute malicious samples. We have observed over 100 IP addresses attempting to exploit this vulnerability.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Step Security reproduced CVE-2026-123158 on an Alpine VM and container: vulnerable OpenSSH on musl without PAM can accept an overlong password for an eligible passwordless account after a failed attempt. Upgrade to OpenSSH 10.6p2 or patched Alpine packages.

author: notCVE
text: ACTIVELY EXPLOITED, added to CISA KEV 2026-11-06. CVE-2026-19868: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability (SAML MFA bypass). CVSS 7.5. Patch SonicOS to 7.3.4 / 8.2.3.

author: 2logics
text: SonicWall said on Friday that it has patched seven vulnerabilities in SonicOS, the operating system on its firewalls, including an SSL VPN flaw that may already be exploited and lets attackers get around SAML logins and multi-factor authentication.

author: cyberspecpro
text: SonicWall CVE-2026-19868: SSL-VPN using SAML can be bypassed by anyone with valid credentials for another login method, MFA included. In CISA KEV since 6 Nov. Fixed in SonicOS 7.3.4-7013 / 8.2.3-8015, no workaround. CVSS 7.1 to 7.5.

author: Real_Willsec
text: CISA KEV: CVE-2026-119977, a WordPress Core race condition, is actively exploited. Predictable staging paths during core upgrades let unauthenticated attackers run code. Fixed in 7.1.4. Federal due date: Nov 6.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: The WordPress deadline passed today. CVE-2026-119977 — the update-window flaw — hit its CISA KEV deadline this week. Patching to WordPress 7.1.4 was step one. Step two is check whether anything got in while you were updating. Unexpected admin users.

author: kesavantcm
text: WordPress Zero-Day Under Active Attack: Hackers are targeting a critical flaw in WordPress—the engine powering nearly 40% of the web. The zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute malicious code on host servers during the update process itself. CISA

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Palo Alto PAN-OS firewalls with the management interface open to the internet are being actively exploited (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Palo Alto rates it Critical, CVSS 9.2.

author: CriminalIP_US
text: FortiMail Zero-Day: Unauthenticated File Write and Gateway Compromise. Actively exploited CVE-2026-104286 (CVSS 9.8, in CISA KEV) allows unauthenticated file writes through FortiMail's management interface, potentially leading to code execution and persistence.

author: CinchOpsIT
text: CISA confirmed a flaw in Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS, and watchOS (CVE-2024-27834) is being actively exploited, reportedly by Russian hackers; added to KEV.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: [!] Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS, watchOS: active exploitation confirmed. Apply Apple security updates. ACTIVELY EXPLOITED - Apple - CVE-2024-27834

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-107441 (CVSS 9.8), a zero-day out-of-bounds write in Zyxel GS1900 dispatcher.cgi, saw active exploitation before Patch 3 fixed it; Patch 2 left the flaw open. Upgrade all GS1900 models to 2.90 Patch 3 and rotate root credentials.

author: ICHI_Global
text: Metasploit modules now available: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway CVE-2026-88771 & CVE-2026-88773 — CISA KEV, unauth RCE, public exploit now live. NetScaler in your environment? CISA patch deadline has passed.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-121614: Docker Sandboxes Unauthenticated Code Execution — Detection. The Zero Day Initiative (ZDI) has published ZDI-26-894, disclosing CVE-2026-121614 — a critical zeroday.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: A public proof-of-concept for CVE-2026-115560 is now circulating. This is the second PHP flaw — the one the October 21 patches did NOT fix. It needs a specific session setup: a serialize_handler mismatch plus session upload progress enabled.

author: lvpcfix
text: CISA has a live, actively exploited RCE in Livewire 3, the component baked into a huge share of Laravel apps, with a fix (3.6.4) that's months overdue on many stacks.

author: UpwindMDR
text: HIGH - 'SlippyNunchucks' Campaign Exploits Sogou Input Method RCE (CVE-2026-120422). An unencrypted HTTP configuration retrieval flaw in the SGTool.exe component of Sogou Input Method for Windows allows network attackers to hijack brand-promotion updates.

author: hongzh0
text: IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218: authenticated user can craft a message to bypass authorization and gain full admin. Affects 5.0.0–5.0.19; fix 5.0.19 PL1. CVSS 3.1:9.8.

author: EnclaveRadar
text: New CVE: CVE-2026-17408 (CVSS 9.8). IBM API Connect · Remote code execution. Remote, no login needed. IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

author: cveintelligence
text: CVE-2026-102435 | Critical 9.8: Ultra Addons for Contact Form 7 (≤3.5.54) – arbitrary file deletion. Unauthenticated attackers can delete files like wp-config.php, which can lead to RCE. No patch listed yet

author: cveintelligence
text: CVE-2026-107622 | Critical 9.8: BuddyForms WordPress plugin (≤2.10.5) – privilege escalation. Unauthenticated attackers can create an administrator account and take over the site. No patch listed yet

author: zoomeyebot
text: Python tarfile extraction filters bypassed for arbitrary file writes. Critical Vulnerability Alert! Python tarfile (CPython) is affected by CVE-2025-4517.

author: 0dayWarlord
text: An FBI agent stole $2.47 million in crypto using credentials tied to 35 investigations. He even stole from a wallet created for an FBI operation. Patrick Steven Yaroch pleaded guilty on November 5 to wire fraud and money laundering, according to DOJ.
